page.notes: Greek forms are transcribed from a small, worn type; accents and breathings on several forms are uncertain and may differ from the printed letters. The "Infinitum" headings are set in italic and the abbreviated Greek letter after them is hard to read; ε is a best reading. Margin notes are Latin glosses on the Optative, Subjunctive and Future forms.
